units.source_text: 回到寺庙后，也没有发生任何的变化。

en.t: Even after I returned to the temple, nothing at all had changed.

units.source_text: 寺庙生活的暗淡、带霉味的永久性，是由今日和明日之间不可能产生任何差异和悬殊所构成的。

en.t: The dim, moldy permanence of life at the temple was made up of the impossibility that any difference or gap could arise between today and tomorrow.

units.source_text: 今天适逢是每月两次讲授教典课中的一天，寺庙的所有人都得聚集在老师的起居室听讲。

en.t: Today happened to be one of the two days each month when the scriptures were lectured on, and everyone in the temple had to gather in the master's sitting room to listen.

units.source_text: 可我却相信老师大概会在众人面前借着讲授"无门关"这一课来责问我。

en.t: But I was convinced that the master would probably use the lecture on "The Gateless Gate" as a pretext to rebuke me in front of everyone.
